video_title: New Best Chair Under $300? | Protoarc Ec300 Vs Ec200
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies ProtoArc as the sponsor of Ahnestly's August 14, 2026 English-language YouTube video, with the video's sponsorship disclosure stating that it is sponsored by ProtoArc. SponsorRadar tracks 16 ProtoArc sponsorships across 10 creators, including Steam Flow at 15K, Steam Deck Gaming at 79K, Ahnestly at 143K, and Joshua Fluke at 623K subscribers. ProtoArc sells tangible ergonomic computer peripherals and office hardware. Its official Affiliate Program says it partners with creators and directs content-only or sponsorship collaborations to its Influencer application; its official contact page publishes marketing@protoarc.com as the dedicated Marketing contact.
